I tested the printer with the filament required for the elective's bridge-design project and confirmed two critical findings: First, the material must be used only in the printer's enclosed configuration with the room's ventilation running. The draft plan currently has an open-printer setting, which is not safe for this material. Second, the project requires exactly two supervised printing sessions each week, but the draft plan still has the original one-session schedule. I completed this test this week, and the safety activation check is completed with its result recorded in the activation packet.
